subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a mutation-based disease?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Malaria**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Malaria** is not a mutation-based disease; it is caused by the Plasmodium parasite, which is transmitted through the bites of infected Anopheles mosquitoes.
 
• On the other hand, **Down syndrome** is a genetic disorder caused by the presence of an extra chromosome 21.
